title: Caller can mutate sealed AuthenticatedDio evidence after LinkLayer issuance
description: Security/correctness self-review of the new fixed DIO fan-out: AuthenticatedDio and AuthenticatedDioOption use frozen dataclasses only. A caller holding the sealed result can use object.__setattr__ to replace internal options, option data/span, IPv6 bytes, DIO bytes, or the receipt snapshot after LinkLayer validation. DioTimeVerifier then trusts those fields without an owning-LinkLayer issuance snapshot check and must not reparse, allowing post-authentication time-option, signer, replay, or provenance substitution. Use an owning-LinkLayer issued-object registry plus immutable structural snapshot acceptance method, or an equivalently nonforgeable sealed representation, and require validation before each fixed consumer derives evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Post-issuance object.__setattr__ mutations of AuthenticatedDio and nested option values are rejected by both time and SCHC-version consumers; exact unmodified same-LinkLayer evidence still fans out to both; validation also proves owning-LinkLayer identity; focused mutation tests cover option data/span, IPv6 bytes, snapshot signer/replay/key generation, and source DIO bytes; Ruff/strict mypy and three independent rereviews pass.
